company.name: FrontierZero
company.shortDescription: FrontierZero is a cybersecurity technology company that provides a SaaS security and management platform.
company.description: FrontierZero offers an AI-powered SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) solution that allows businesses to manage cybersecurity, compliance, and SaaS costs from a single dashboard. The platform detects identity risks, shadow IT applications, and security vulnerabilities while automating threat detection and incident response.
